name: Humblewood Subclasses (2024)
_note: Standalone subclasses that attach to a base class by name. Cleric domain spell lists reference three Humblewood spells (Veil of Dusk, Globe of Twilight, Stellar Bodies), marked * in the descriptions; these are now defined in humblewood-spells.json.

subclasses.name: College of the Road
subclasses.description: A wandering bard's college of travelers and scofflaws, trading in tricks and hard-won road wisdom.

traits.name: Bonus Proficiencies
traits.description: Choose three of the following (each once): proficiency with a Gaming Set; a martial weapon; Herbalism Kits; Thieves' Tools; a skill of your choice; or two languages of your choice.

traits.name: Traveler's Tricks
traits.description: You learn two Traveler's Tricks of your choice (see the book's Traveler's Trick options), and one more at 6th and 14th level. Each trick expends a use of Bardic Inspiration and takes a Bonus Action unless noted.

traits.name: Wanderer's Lore
traits.description: When a creature has a Bardic Inspiration die from you, they may make one Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion check with Advantage, choosing whether to also add the die.

traits.name: Favorite Trick
traits.description: Designate one Traveler's Trick you know as your favorite. If you roll Initiative with no Bardic Inspiration left, you regain one use — usable only for your favorite trick. At 14th level you may name a second favorite trick.

traits.name: Improved Tricks
traits.description: At 6th and 14th level your Traveler's Tricks grow stronger (see the book's improved trick options).

subclasses.name: Community Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics who bind and sustain communities — providers, protectors, and keepers of the hearth.

traits.name: Community Domain Spells
traits.description: You always have these prepared at the listed Cleric level — 3rd: Aid, Bless, Goodberry, Heroism · 5th: Beacon of Hope, Spirit Guardians · 7th: Banishment, Faithful Hound · 9th: Mass Cure Wounds, Telepathic Bond.

traits.name: Blessing of the Hearth
traits.description: Whenever you rest you can conjure a small hearth and cooking pot. When you or friendly creatures camped with you spend Hit Point Dice at the end of a Short Rest, each may re-roll one die and take the higher result. You also gain proficiency with Cook's Utensils.

traits.name: Magnificent Feast
traits.description: As a Magic action, expend a use of Channel Divinity and 10 minutes to create a number of simple food items equal to your Wisdom modifier (min 1) that last up to 8 hours. Eating one (an Action) restores 2d4 + your Cleric level Hit Points and can remove the Frightened or Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Community Watch
traits.description: As a Magic action, expend a use of Channel Divinity to grant yourself and up to your Wisdom modifier of allies (within 30 ft, able to see you) a boon: once per round a benefitting creature can roll a d6 and add it to a D20 Test, for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier.

traits.name: Divine Strike
traits.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 Psychic damage (2d8 at 14th level). You also choose whether a foe reduced to 0 HP by the strike is stable or dies.

traits.name: Paragon of the People
traits.description: Community Watch grants an extra d6 to each ally and immunity to Fear for its duration. Magnificent Feast produces twice as many foods, each of which can also remove a single curse or disease (including cursed-item attunement) when consumed.

subclasses.name: Night Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics of the night — shadow-wardens who protect their companions by peering through darkness to find the truth.

traits.name: Eye of Twilight
traits.description: You can see in Dim Light within 60 ft as if Bright, and in Darkness (magical or not) as if Dim (shades of gray only). At 6th level this extends to 120 ft.

traits.name: Night Domain Spells
traits.description: Always prepared at the listed Cleric level — 3rd: Darkness, Moonbeam, Sleep, Veil of Dusk* · 5th: Nondetection, Globe of Twilight* · 7th: Divination, Stellar Bodies* · 9th: Dream, Seeming. (* new spells found in this book.)

traits.name: Ward of Shadows
traits.description: When a creature you can see within 30 ft attacks you, use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage as shadows envelop you (an attacker immune to Blinded is unaffected). Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (min 1), regained on a Long Rest. At 8th level you see normally in Darkness within 120 ft; at 17th you can grant yourself Truesight 120 ft (in Darkness) for Wis-modifier minutes, once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Invocation of Night
traits.description: As a Magic action, expend a use of Channel Divinity to extinguish all mundane and magical light within 30 ft; each hostile creature within 30 ft must make a Constitution save or be Blinded for a number of rounds equal to your Cleric level (repeating the save at end of turn; Total Cover negates).

traits.name: Improved Ward
traits.description: You can use Ward of Shadows when a creature you can see within 30 ft attacks a creature other than you.

traits.name: Veil of Dreams
traits.description: When you cast Sleep you can increase the Sphere's radius to 10 feet, and a target that fails its first save has Disadvantage on its second save against falling asleep.

traits.name: Creature of the Night
traits.description: As an Action, project a 1-minute aura: Heavily Obscuring Darkness in a 30-ft radius and Lightly Obscuring shadows 50 ft beyond, smothering light (only a 9th-level spell or similar can negate it). Enemies in the shadows are Frightened; enemies in the Darkness are Blinded and Frightened while they remain.

subclasses.name: Scofflaw
subclasses.description: A fighter who hits hard and fights dirty — using every trick, taunt, and cheap shot to win, and eventually a fearsome reputation.

traits.name: Bonus Proficiency
traits.description: Gain proficiency in one of Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth — or instead learn Thieves' Cant.

traits.name: Brutal Brawler
traits.description: You have proficiency with improvised weapons and treat any you wield as having the Finesse property. When you hit with an improvised weapon you may use a Bonus Action to break it, destroying it but dealing the maximum of its damage dice (bonus dice unaffected). At 10th level, add 2d6 to that break's damage; at 18th, you have Advantage on improvised-weapon attacks.

traits.name: Intimidating Banter
traits.description: While in combat, you may use Strength or Dexterity in place of Charisma for Charisma checks.

traits.name: Misdirection
traits.description: As a Bonus Action, misdirect an opponent within 5 ft (Intelligence save vs DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + your Str or Dex modifier). On a failure they must spend their Reaction to attack a creature of your choice within 5 ft of them (or waste it). They must be able to perceive and understand you.

traits.name: Blindside
traits.description: Against a creature that hasn't yet taken a turn, one you've misdirected this turn, or any attack you make with Advantage, deal an extra 5d6 damage on a hit (7d6 at 15th, 9d6 at 18th). Once per Short or Long Rest; if you have no uses when you roll Initiative, you regain one.

traits.name: Infamy
traits.description: When you make an attack, you can utter deadly threats at one target within 30 ft (Wisdom save vs DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + your Str or Dex modifier) or they are Frightened of you for 1 minute (repeating the save at end of turn). A creature that knows your reputation saves with Disadvantage. They must be able to perceive and understand you.

traits.name: Two for Flinching
traits.description: When you take the Attack action against an opponent you've misdirected this turn or one afflicted by a condition, you may make one additional attack against it. Once per round.

subclasses.name: Deep Roots
subclasses.description: A sorcerous origin drawn from the natural magic of the land itself. Living batteries, these sorcerers absorb, store, and redirect energy through bodies shaped by the terrain around them. (Humblewood 2 Playtest.)

traits.name: In Tune with the Land
traits.description: You know the druidcraft cantrip, and you can understand and speak Terran.

traits.name: Grounded Magic
traits.description: You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown here. Each counts as a sorcerer spell for you but doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know. 1st: create or destroy water, entangle. 3rd: barkskin, shatter. 5th: revivify, vampiric touch. 7th: control water, stone shape. 9th: commune with nature, hallow.

traits.name: Natural Battery
traits.description: When you are hit by an attack that deals magical damage, or cold, fire, force, lightning, or radiant damage, you can use your reaction to halve the damage you take and add a d6 to your Natural Battery dice pool. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest. When you hit a creature with an attack, you can spend any number of d6s from your Natural Battery dice pool to add a bonus to the attack's damage, choosing the type from cold, fire, force, or lightning. You lose any remaining dice in your pool when you finish a long rest. At 9th level these dice increase to d8s, and at 17th level to d10s.

traits.name: Land's Harmony
traits.description: Depending on the terrain you most recently finished a long rest in, you gain one of the following benefits until you finish your next long rest. Arctic: resistance to cold damage. Coast: cast water breathing once per day without a spell slot. Desert: resistance to fire damage. Forest: cast speak with plants once per day without a spell slot. Grassland: your walking speed increases by 5 feet, and you can Disengage as a bonus action. Mountain: cast call lightning once per day without a spell slot. Swamp: you ignore nonmagical difficult terrain.

traits.name: Home Turf
traits.description: When you take a short rest, you can add one die to your Natural Battery dice pool. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Charged Up
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can convert any number of dice in your Natural Battery dice pool into sorcery points.
